newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower as top blue chips retreat.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower as top blue chips retreat.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index closed moderately lower on Monday, paring its losses after briefly dipping below the key support point of 19,500.

The market was weighed down by growing scepticism over Japan's economic recovery, prompting profit-taking in leading blue-chip issues, brokers said. They added that Tokyo stocks may continue to consolidate until the end of this month.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 136.31 points or 0.69 percent to close at 19,668.07. It briefly slid as low as 19,456.95. September Nikkei futures fell 10 points to end at 19,790.
